name: New-maintenance net posthook fallback when procedure yields $0
what_it_tests: New-maintenance lines where the procedure leaves NetUnitPrice null/$0 must be populated by the posthook fallback using Source_List_Price x MTD tier x partner/software factors
proc_mechanism: PartnerNetPricePosthook (v1.4+) buildNewMaintenanceUpdate + loadNewMaintenanceLines; gates on NetUnitPrice null/<=0 AND Source_List_Price>0 AND Fortra_Product_Type='New Maintenance'
expected_behavior: Net = Source_List_Price x Maintenance_Rate(MTD tier) x (1-partner%) x (1-software%); posthook finalizes after procedure
